Topic: Melbourne

586 items include the topic of Melbourne.

Melbourne is the Victorian capital and the city Keith Dunstan spent his career chronicling, from its football-mad suburbs and blue-blooded Toorak drawing rooms to its vanishing pubs and theatres, in a body of Bulletin, Sun and Herald writing that amounts to an intimate social history of the city across six decades.
